notes.title: New tanks and game mode! Patch notes v1.03g
notes.notes:
[b]Hey guys![/b]

This Battle Bolts update comes with a brand new game mode called "Racing", as well as 2 brand new tanks, the long anticipated return to lobby option and some balance changes!
We plan to keep improving the racing game mode based on the community feedback, as well as general game balance. All feedback is welcome!

[h1]Two new tanks! [/h1]
[b]Medusa Tank[/b]
-Front weapon ability “Split Shot” On impact deals 3 damage and splits into 2 cannonballs each dealing 1 damage on impact
-Side weapon ability “Bounce Grenade” Grenade that bounces 2 additional times with diminished effects

[b]Ranger tank[/b]
-Front weapon ability “Heavy Cannon Ball“ Deals 3 damage and knocks targets back 1 tile
-Side weapon ability “Nuke” Grenade with massive explosion radius

[h1]Balance changes
[/h1]
[b]Banshee[/b]
-Front special damage reduced from 4 to 3, pull is still present
-Side special will now try to pull diagonal targets to middle tile.Middle tile damage reduced from 4 to 2. Does not explode above open pits

[b]Volt
[/b]-Front special now deals 3 damage to initial and any chained targets. Chain radius is still 2 tiles around impact.

[b]Bullseye[/b]
-Front special now deals 3 damage to all pierced targets

[h1]AI Improvements
[/h1]-Less Predicatable 
-Decreased difficulty
-Dash is now reliably executed and incorporated into overall strategy


[h1]New Race Mode 
[/h1]-Players can now race in this new fun mode. Goal is to end turn on a tile highlighted in player color. All other mechanics apply
-Added 3 race arenas (SHIFTY LANES, CROSSROADS and DRIVE-THRU)

[h1]Game improvements [/h1]
-Improvements to network stability and bug fixes
-Players will now see each other’s usernames when in the same lobby
-Players return to lobby after match has ended

notes.title: Battle Bolts out of Early Access - and Fight Night Events!
notes.notes:
[h1]Greetings, soldiers![/h1]

We are pleased to announce that [b]Battle Bolts is out of Early Access[/b]! 

This version of the game comes with all sorts of upgrades to the pre-EA game, including a [b]shinier HUD, lots more maps to play on and most importantly, an online multiplayer mode[/b] where you can play with (and against) real friends (and foes!) from all over the world!

Since the game is best enjoyed in multiplayer against real opponents, we are going to host a [b]series of online community events[/b] - and you are invited to come along! Our first event will be [b]happening today[/b]: [i]May 25th, 2019 at 5:00 PM / 17:00 UTC[/i].

The events will take place in [b]Croteam's official Discord server[/b]. Be sure you [url=https://discord.gg/croteam]join the server[/url], and stay to chill with us and other players! 
After all, there is no better place to bond with your fellow comrades than the battlefield!

[b]To stay notified about more Battle Bolts news and events, make sure you follow our social media pages!

notes.title: Battle Bolts is live!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32944419/31fffeb9088762e4d2a2f815a806f5b6f9e16c4e.jpg[/img]

:hi: all,

welcome to [b]Battle Bolts[/b] Early Access. First of all, if you're reading this, thank you for showing your interest in the game and to all those who decide to buy the game, thank you for your support. 

And our Battle Bolts development in this past week was just as an old Latin saying: [i]Per aspera ad astra[/i]. When we thought we were ready for Steam, something went wrong with the build and it was declined by Steam. It took us a few days to get it all sorted, but we still missed original release date, March 25. Luckily, we managed to wrap everything up pretty fast so release was postponed only till today, March 28. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32944419/3664e768f1f88001f399867b8c26d55a223a303d.jpg[/img]

[b]Enter Battle Bolts.[/b] It's a video game with a board game aesthetics, which might look simple at first, but takes some time to master. The basic premise is to fight against your friends in an 8x8 arena, full of stuff that can either help you or set you back. The trick is to program not one but several (in this iteration: 4) commands ahead, and hope you are better at predicting your opponents than they are at predicting you. All commands execute at the same time (mostly), and Battle Bolts soon becomes a game of cat and mouse. Except both have four moves to plan ahead.

The game went through several iterations and was showcased at both local and international gaming shows. Seeing how much fun people had with it, we decided to show and share one of those earlier versions here and gather your thoughts. It's still a bit rough around the edges and we still have to implement multiplayer, which won't take long, but it's already playable and, hopefully, fun. :)

For the best experience, grab 3 friends, 4 controllers and 4 beers (if you are of legal age to buy beer, of course). You can play against bots, but mind that AI leaves a lot to be desired, so real people are your best option!

We hope you will enjoy the game and if you have any ideas and suggestions, please post them on our forums so we can gather useful and constructive feedback. 

The battle awaits, soldier! :lunar2019piginablanket:

notes.title: Battle Bolts release news
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32944419/181df87d252051c3c95ce7f0f79a133458200410.jpg[/img]

Hey guys,

sadly, we’ll have to postpone Battle Bolts release for some time (but not too long!). and we apologize for this. We had some technical problems and made some decisions that took a bit longer than expected to implement, and before we can hit that “publish” button, there’s still some coding and fixing left to do. 

It’s really important for us to give you stable and fun game to play and once we enter Early Access, we are counting on your feedback to help us polish Battle Bolts to perfection!

Please stay tuned on our social channels ([url=https://twitter.com/BattleBolts]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.facebook.com/battlebolts/]Facebook[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/battlebolts/]Instagram[/url]) as well as Croteam’s [url=https://discord.gg/spr2ESd]Discord[/url] for news and updates!

Zenoslaf
